inventory.scope: Two pressure transmitters explicitly enumerated for plant-07; no claim about unenumerated I/O or hidden PLC dependencies.

scope.time_support: Current subscription stream from 17:00 UTC onward; history before that time is excluded.
scope.network_scope: Read-only site VLAN gateway path only.

channels.unit_semantics: Source returns psi; no implicit unit conversion.
channels.timestamp_semantics: Source observed-at with PTP domain and declared 0.5 ms bound.
channels.sampling_semantics: Subscription sequence; duplicates tracked by source sequence.

capture_contract.sequence_semantics: Monotonic source sequence within one connector session; session reset is surfaced as a new stream epoch.
capture_contract.watermark_semantics: Highest contiguous source sequence fully observed.

known_blind_spots: Unenumerated PLC inputs and channels outside the pinned inventory are not observable through this profile.
